name.zh-CN: 抛物线求交与拱桥水位

catalogDescription.zh-CN: 水平线或斜线求交、移项判别式、韦达根距与桥孔水位宽度
catalogDescription.en: Reduced quadratic coefficients, horizontal and oblique intersections, Vieta relations, chord length and bridge water level

teachingPurpose.zh-CN: 水平线或斜线求交、移项判别式、韦达根距与桥孔水位宽度
teachingPurpose.en: Reduced quadratic coefficients, horizontal and oblique intersections, Vieta relations, chord length and bridge water level

a.description: 二次项系数 / quadratic coefficient; 0.01 grid

b.description: 一次项系数 / linear coefficient; 0.01 grid

slope.description: 直线斜率 / line slope; ignored in horizontal and bridge scenes

intercept.description: 截线高度或直线截距 / water level or line intercept

scene.description: 水平求交、直线联立、拱桥示意 / horizontal, line or bridge

showDistance.description: 显示水平根距与斜弦长 / show horizontal separation and chord length

patchHints.zh-CN: 只修改用户要求的教学参数，其余字段保留。
patchHints.en: Patch only the requested teaching parameters and preserve the rest.

patchHints.zh-CN: 拱桥示例a=-0.4,b=0,c=9,intercept=3；韦达与根距使用移项后的b-slope与c-intercept，不能继续套用原式b,c。横坐标差与斜弦长度分开。普通ax²+bx+c=0及复根优先用math.quadratic-equation。
patchHints.en: Use reduced coefficients b−slope and c−intercept for the discriminant and Vieta relations. Horizontal root separation differs from the sloping chord. A standard quadratic equation, including complex roots, belongs to math.quadratic-equation.

fallbackConditions.zh-CN: 本组件不处理：船高净空与航行安全判定、任意曲线求交、三维结构分析。
fallbackConditions.en: Vessel headroom or navigation safety, arbitrary curves, or three-dimensional structural analysis.

examplePrompts.zh-CN: 桥下水位上涨，水面处还能有多宽？
examplePrompts.en: How does the opening width change as the water level rises under a parabolic arch?

examplePrompts.zh-CN: 斜线和抛物线求交时，判别式为什么也变了？
examplePrompts.en: Why must the discriminant change when intersecting a parabola with an oblique line?

excludes: 船高净空与航行安全判定
